The 4 used GPU and RAM sold-price datasets for sale (live_gpu_ram_prices, gpu_ram_sold_7d, gpu_ram_sold_14d, gpu_ram_sold_30d): id, title, description, row count, field names, created_at (freshness), a few sample rows and the USDC price buy_dataset will charge. JSON output.
